versions.subject: Merge PR #5568 from @Koifman - Password Never Expires Set via WMI
versions.detection:
selection_img:   # Example command simulated:  wmic  useraccount where name='guest' set passwordexpires=false
    - Image|endswith: '\wmic.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'wmic.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'useraccount'
        - ' set '
        - 'passwordexpires'
        - 'false'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\wmic.exe" OR OriginalFileName="wmic.exe" CommandLine="*useraccount*" CommandLine="* set *" CommandLine="*passwordexpires*" CommandLine="*false*"
